moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-infinite-marquee, written here): Track = text + ' • ' repeated (two copies, x 0 → −50 % in the recipe, 10–20 s per copy, linear, seamless). Demo rows: 26 px filled ink moving left; 30 px in the background colour on a full-width accent band 1.64 em tall moving right; 26 px outline only (1.2 px) moving left; each moves a whole number of copies per 6 s loop (≈40 px/s in a 320 px demo). Both frame edges fade into the background over 34 px. Params: tốc độ (≈ 8 s mỗi chiều rộng khung) · kiểu hàng (đặc / dải / viền) · ký tự ngăn (•).
